description: For a point ultrafilter, the evaluation isomorphism \([f]\mapsto f(i_0)\) and the diagonal map \(a\mapsto[i\mapsto a]\) are inverse maps in both directions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Ultraproducts.principal_ultrapower_inverse.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {I : Type w} {A : Type w'} [L.Structure A] [Nonempty A] (i₀ : I) :
  ∃ e,
    (∀ (f : I → A), e (Quotient.mk' f) = f i₀) ∧
      (∀ (a : A), e ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Ultraproducts.diagonal (pure i₀)) a) = a) ∧
        ∀ (x : (↑(pure i₀)).Product fun x => A),
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Ultraproducts.diagonal (pure i₀)) (e x) = x
